Genspark’s Rebirth in Agents ⟳

Genspark’s shift to Agents really started around April, 2025. They have raised around $160 million to date and their revenue is increasing rapidly. 

Since Genspark’s pivot from search to agents, it’s seen incredible growth. In mid 2025, a 20-person team grew ARR to $36 million in about 45 days, according to OpenAI. While their Super agent has been getting a lot of attention, so have their constant feature updates. 

Try It

Genspark’s feature updates of new agentic capabilities has been relentless: 

Genspark is one of those pseudo Chinese-American U.S. startups. They are based in Palo Alto, California and founded in 2023 by former Baidu executives Eric Jing and Kay Zhu.

Read their Blog.

Visit their Subreddit. 

In June, 2025 Genspark announced Parallel Tool Calls for AI Agents. In July Genspark shipped no-code personal agents with GPT-4.1. 

As of mid-July Genspark ranks 16th on Henry Shi’s AI Startup Leaderboard, though I don’t think that’s up to date. 

🌱 There is a pop-myth that an AI native and lean startup or solopreneur might build the next Unicorn. (Remember Base44 - an $80 million exit in six months?)
